title: Evaluation of the middle circuit layer
statement: Let $m\ge 7$ and let $x$ be a sign string with $2^m$ coordinates. Evaluate the middle layer by feeding each of its OR gates the outputs of the corresponding first-layer AND gates, then take the AND of all those OR outputs. The resulting sign equals the value of the parity conjunctive normal form on the length-$m$ sign pattern whose entry at block $b$ is the parity sign of the two-block restriction of $x$ selected for $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign string with $2^m$ coordinates
